name: aiworkflow
description: The slice-development workflow, packaged as installable Claude Code plugins for KubeCoder projects.

plugins.name: dev
plugins.description: The kc-native slice pipeline: triage in chat, then plan-slice and run-slice as stages Pilot runs, driven by a bounded per-phase dev loop (write → test → review → merge) over the slice's plan.md, with one close-out report per slice for everything out of the loops' scope, answered in Pilot as the run's continuation.
